The '''Cartel Mining Mesa''' was a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It housed the [[Drilling Platform Fwanna]] during the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] [[Conquest of Makeb|takeover]] of the planet.<ref name="TOR" />
